messages:
matt: Quick flag — the Embeddings API doc example on /api/embeddings is wrong. It shows `input: "single string"` but our runtime expects `inputs: [string]` for batch. Using the current example gets a 400.

carmen: ouch. can you paste the exact snippet/link?

matt: sure: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/docs/api/embeddings.md line ~42. PR started: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3456 (WIP).

sylvia: we also mirror that in SDK snippets. i can update python/go/ruby once we agree on canonical example.

kevin: also check the response example — I saw `embedding` singular instead of `embeddings` array. that'll break codegen tests.

matt: yup current page shows `{ "embedding": [0.1, 0.2] }`. Correct is `{ "embeddings": [[...], [...]] }` for batch.

jordan: heads up CI will fail if examples and OpenAPI don't match. i'll re-run codegen once PR lands.

matt: my plan: switch main example to a batch array, add a short compatibility note about single-string shims, update OpenAPI examples and SDK snippets, and add a migration blurb. Example to use in PR: curl POST with `{"model":"open-embedding-1","inputs":["first","second"]}` and Python snippet showing res.embeddings -> [[...],[...]].

carmen: single canonical batch example + one-line note about wrapping single strings works for me. keeps page concise.

kevin: add migration text: some older SDKs accepted a bare string and coerced it; new SDKs require array. link to migration guide.

sylvia: pushed updated snippets to the branch. also added a tiny unit in the docs snippet tests to validate request serialization against the OpenAPI example.

matt: i updated openapi/spec.yaml examples in the branch to match the batch shape. pushed curl + python examples, left TODOs for Go/Ruby. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3456 (embeds-batch-example).

deploy-bot: deploy preview available: https://deploy-preview-3456--docs.redwood.ai :rocket: (expires in 7 days)

kevin: small nit — update the marketing examples too, they sometimes copy docs snippets.

carmen: agreed, and add a docs test that tries single-string and array and asserts examples validate against schema.

sylvia: merged snippet updates after review. left the compatibility note with a tiny single-item example in a separate callout.

matt: merged main changes. CI flagged codegen mapping: our codegen used `data` historically, but OpenAPI expects `embeddings`. jordan?

jordan: created a patch in codegen-tooling to align response names (see github.com/redwood-inference/codegen/issues/812). will roll out tomorrow and re-run docs generation.

kevin: once codegen patch lands, re-run snippet tests and remove the temporary duplicate compatibility example. we shouldn't keep two canonical examples long-term.

matt: final checklist in PR: changelog entry, redirect from old example URL, migration note, update marketing copy, verify snippet CI. thanks folks :thumbsup:
